name: site-shot
description: Website screenshots for AI agents: real Chromium, full-page capture, ISO-code country proxies, automatic ad & cookie-banner removal. Wraps the published site-shot-mcp stdio server.

SITESHOT_API_KEY.title: Site-Shot API key
SITESHOT_API_KEY.description: Your Site-Shot API key (sent to the API as userkey). Requires a paid Site-Shot API plan; captures use that account's existing API allowance and limits. Get the key from your Site-Shot dashboard (https://www.site-shot.com/dashboard/); plans are listed at https://www.site-shot.com/pricing/.
